metrics.all_case_policy: Every original test row remains in denominator; missing/invalid predictions count incorrect.

Closest native full-description comparator21.91% accuracy, ProtST Table11 printedp15 (rounded); paper pretraining-name29.85% is a separate label-text variant. Native text embeddings truncate each description at128tokens; Qwen receives all complete descriptions jointly.

likely_demands.status: provisional analyst description; internal computation unknown

interpretation.actually_supplied: Archived full original amino-acid sequence, fixed classification objective and all384 complete source pretraining-template descriptions, including alternative names/comments. No per-protein target label, retrieval, tools or fewshot examples.
interpretation.reference_answer_source: Pinned native EC-derived Reaction integer class0..383 from original held-out LMDB; fixed global ontology constructed from official public class tables independently of test labels. Reference file hashed before inference and opened after output lock.
interpretation.good_score_establishes: Recovery of source outcomes on the declared released test under the fixed zero-shot protocol.
interpretation.bad_score_establishes: Limited outcome recovery for this input/regime; does not independently establish deficient general reasoning.
interpretation.explanation_correctness: Unassessed; correct prediction does not certify rationale and unsupported mechanism is not automatically false.

contamination: Reference labels excluded, inputs frozen, outputs hash-locked before scoring, no training or test-guided changes. Prior exposure to public source data unknown.
shard_metric_interpretation: Partial task only. Full-test native384-class accuracy is computed separately from the complete union of raw predictions; shard metric values must never be averaged.
